arguments.description: Pixel art game HUD head-and-shoulders portrait, Rimuru Tempest WEARING SHIZU ORIGINAL ANTI-MAGIC MASK. Vivid pale cyan-blue straight hair and bangs. Entire face is a smooth IVORY WHITE MASK: two dark charcoal hooked jagged lines on upper cheeks, a dark broad curved line across lower mask, tiny RED circle at center. Mask has NO eye holes, NO visible eyes, NO skin or human mouth. Cream fur scarf, cobalt-blue coat. Front view, clean crisp limited-palette pixel art, transparent background, portrait fills64x64 canvas.
